note: Silent AI b-roll for the social posts and ads, generated on Higgsfield before the Starter credits expired (2026-11-07). Hands only, never faces: nobody is presented as a customer. Re-encoded from the 1080x1920 originals at x264 CRF 22, no audio. Two came out sideways and are stored rotated as 16:9 landscape. AI paper often carries fake lettering: prompts ask for 'soft blurred grey lines', and notes flag every clip with visible pseudo-text — keep those cuts short or soft.
